JSON to TypeScript

Convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces — nested objects, arrays, unions and optional detection.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your JSON sample.
  2. Set the root interface name.
  3. Toggle export and optional-field handling.
  4. Copy the interfaces or download types.ts.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are nested objects handled?

Each nested object becomes its own named interface (ParentKey + suffix), so the output compiles cleanly.

How are arrays typed?

From their items — a single type when uniform, a union when mixed, unknown[] when empty.

What does "optional for nulls" do?

Fields whose sample value is null become optional (field?: type | null) since the real type is unknown.

Does the output compile?

Yes — valid TypeScript with no dependencies. Run tsc --noEmit to verify.
